declare
 procedure format_error is
 temp_format varchar2(100);
 temp_pos number;
 begin
 temp_format := upper(GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 -- remove FM or FX format prefix
 if substr(temp_format,1,2) in ('FX','FM') then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,3);
 end if;
 -- remove double quotes and change 0 to 9
 temp_format := translate(temp_format,'0"','9');
 -- change HH24 to HH
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'HH24');
 if temp_pos != 0 then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'HH'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 4);
 end if;
 -- change multiple RR to YY
 loop
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'RR');
 exit when temp_pos = 0;
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'YY'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 2);
 end loop;
 show_error('0022',temp_format );
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error('1700');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error('1701');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('1702');
 elsif error_code = 41830 --list values contains no entries
 then
 show_error('12019');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error('1703');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error('0080');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error('1704');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error('1705');
 elsif error_code = 41800 --list not available
 then
 show_error('1180');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('5050');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error('8010');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error('8013');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50026)
 then
 format_error;
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 format_error;
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 format_error;
 elsif error_code in ('0','40209') -- invalid format
 then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 else
 message(substr(error_type||'-'||to_char (error_code)
 ||': '||error_text,1,80));
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_DRIVE_DATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/**************************************************************************************
* This function validates the drive date
* The drive date must be between system date and the PARAMETERISED number of days
* The drive date can not be greater than system date
***************************************************************************************/

FUNCTION validate_drive_date RETURN boolean IS
 temp varchar2(5);
 number_of_days_param number;
 chp_sysdate date;
BEGIN
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 
 if :ctrl_block_1.drive_date2 > to_date(:ctrl_block_1.i_date,'mmddyyyy') then
 SHOW_ERROR('16167'); 
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE; 
 end if;

 BEGIN
 Select parameter_value into number_of_days_param from valid_parameters
 where parameter_code = 'UPDTE_DRIV' and 
 chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+1);
 exception
 when others then
 HANDLE_ERROR;
 return FALSE;
 END ;

 if :ctrl_block_1.drive_date2 < chp_sysdate - number_of_days_param or 
 :ctrl_block_1.drive_date2 > chp_sysdate then
 clear_item;
 SHOW_ERROR('16139');
 return FALSE;
 else
 return TRUE;
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_NEW_TIME
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION get_new_time(old_time_in IN DATE) RETURN DATE IS
 ld_old_time DATE;
 ld_new_time DATE := NULL;
BEGIN
 IF old_time_in IS NOT NULL THEN
 ld_old_time := old_time_in;
 -- convert time to local if tz enabled.
 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 ld_old_time := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled,
 :GLOBAL.tz_offset,
 old_time_in);
 END IF;
 
 -- Update just the date portion with the new coll. dt. 
 ld_new_time := TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(:donations.new_coll_date, 'MMDDYYYY') || ' ' ||
 TO_CHAR(ld_old_time, 'HH24:MI'),
 'MMDDYYYY HH24:MI');
 
 -- convert back the time to gmt
 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 ld_new_time := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 ld_new_time);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 -- returns NULL if the input parameter is NULL OR returns the new time.
 RETURN ld_new_time;
END get_new_time;
